context: A boss and his manager discuss a science-policy column
purpose: Teach: 落下/最高裁判所/拒絶/探求/力学/神学/高層/個体

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、高層ビルの落下事故と最高裁判所の判例の話だな。
lines.en: This article—high-rise falling accidents and Supreme Court precedent cases.
lines.style: Measured, analytical opening. Slight pause on the dash. Scanning mode—turning pages or text mentally. Calm authority without weight. Registering details as he speaks them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者側の主張、企業の拒絶反応、両面から書いてます。
lines.en: Yes. It addresses both sides—victim claims and corporate pushback.
lines.style: Respectful clarity. Direct eye contact feel. Organized, checking boxes. Professional but not stiff. Ready to elaborate if needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 力学的な原因探求、徹底すべきだろう。
lines.en: Mechanical cause-investigation needs to be rigorous.
lines.style: Firmer conviction now. Light emphasis on 'rigorous.' Not a suggestion—a standard. Experienced judgment delivering a principle. Short, definitive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 神学的な議論まで踏み込んでる箇所もあります。
lines.en: Some sections venture into theological argument.
lines.style: Slight surprise in the tone—noting something unexpected but credible. Thoughtful pause before 'theological.' Acknowledging scope and ambition. Measured interest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 個体差を考慮した分析が必要だな。
lines.en: Analysis that accounts for individual variation—that's what's needed.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on 'individual variation.' Speaking from experience. Not commanding—prescribing from judgment. Slight trailing pause, giving weight to the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Quiet, compact. Respectful close. No ornament. The kind of acknowledgment that signals readiness to move forward.
